description: Revert to the empirically proven "Gold Standard" configuration (Depth=8, Matrix LR=0.06, Weight Decay=0.1, Batch=128) to ensure stable convergence and achieve the lowest val_bpb (~0.9901), as all previous attempts to increase capacity (OOM/Time), reduce capacity (underfit), or tweak learning rates (instability) have failed to improve upon this baseline.
